child_service_not_found.message: Action {domain}.{service} uses action {child_domain}.{child_service} which was not found.

deprecated_long_lived_access_token_step_.description:
The long-lived access token "{client_name}" was used for `{command}`. Changes like this need a recent sign-in or a confirmation of your identity, which a long-lived access token can't give. From Home Assistant 2027.5, they will be refused for long-lived access tokens.

If a tool uses this token to manage users or passwords, check if it supports signing in instead, or make these changes in **Settings** > **People**.
deprecated_long_lived_access_token_step_.title: Long-lived access token "{client_name}" needs to stop changing passwords
